title: Churn Survival — Dual Classifier + Survival + Uplift Retention Policy

modules.dataset: Subscription churn ETL with (duration, event) survival indicators. Synthetic generator with Cox proportional hazards + Weibull baseline (λ=0.0012, ρ=1.4) producing ~40% observed churn rate. Real-world Telco dataset download (IBM Watson sample) with synthetic fallback.
modules.model: Dual-modeling: (1) Standard classifiers (LogReg, RandomForest) with ColumnTransformer preprocessing; (2) Survival analysis via Kaplan-Meier (population curve) + Cox PH (covariate-adjusted individual risk). C-index computed via lifelines.concordance_index. Uplift via two-model approach (P_churn|control − P_churn|treatment). Expected-value policy ranks customers by uplift × LTV − offer_cost and finds the optimal targeting threshold via cumulative ROI maximization.
modules.train: argparse CLI: --csv, --use-real, --n-samples, --seed, --test-size, --skip-classifier/survival/uplift, --offer-cost, --metrics-json, --survival-plot, --uplift-plot. Outputs ROC-AUC/Brier for classifiers, C-index for Cox PH, and optimal ROI + targeting threshold for uplift.
modules.tests: 17 tests: dataset schema, churn-rate sanity, stratified split churn-rate preservation, classifier metrics sanity, KM non-increasing survival + bounded [0,1] + starts at 1, Cox C-index in [0,1] + recovers ground-truth coefficient directions, C-index perfect/random ranking, uplift basic math, expected-value optimal threshold + negative-EV skip, CLI smoke test.
